title: Developer sign-in and QA role switcher
summary: Local Herd installs gain a Developer sign-in panel and QA role switcher for fake test profiles. The feature stays off in testing, staging and production.
changes: With QA_LOGIN_ENABLED and APP_ENV=local, /login and /staff/login show an amber Developer sign-in panel (Local only) for one-click sign-in as account types and common staff stacks; /qa is the same panel as a fallback.
Signed-in QA accounts see an amber QA pill that switches profile in place and offers Sign out of QA; ordinary accounts keep normal Sign out.
QA accounts use random unknown passwords; the shared QA password constant is removed. Demo account password sign-in on /staff/login is unchanged.
Step-up for QA accounts uses a Confirm QA profile prompt instead of a password; every QA sign-in, switch and sign-out is audited with method qa.
Automated tests and the Cloudron deploy script keep the feature off outside local Herd; QA_LOGIN_ENABLED must stay unset on Cloudron.
version_rationale: Patch: local-only developer tooling with no production behaviour change when the flag is unset.
validation: PHPUnit QaLoginTest coverage for gate-off, production/staging/testing, panel, pill, switch, return paths, step-up, audit and deploy check passed locally.
composer pre-pr-verify and CI checks on the milestone pull request.
known_limitations: Developer sign-in works only on local Herd with QA_LOGIN_ENABLED=true. Live admin log-in-as-user is out of scope and never planned.
rollback: Deploy v0.64.2 with deploy-cloudron.yml. Local installs lose the Developer sign-in panel and QA pill until a later release; production is unchanged when the flag was unset.
provenance: Milestone v0.64.3 Dev: Developer sign-in and QA role switcher, epic #834 with issues #835–#842; pull request #843.
